I'm really glad you told me. You deserve support right now, and you don't have to go through this alone.

- Call or text **9-8-8** (Suicide Crisis Helpline) - free, 24/7, in English or French.
- If you are in immediate danger, call **9-1-1** or go to the nearest emergency department.
- Young people can also reach Kids Help Phone: 1-800-668-6868 or text CONNECT to 686868.
- Indigenous peoples can reach the Hope for Wellness Help Line: 1-855-242-3310.

If you can, reach out to someone you trust and let them know how you're feeling. I'm an information tool, not a crisis service, so please contact one of these lines now.

_MapleMind gives general information, not medical advice or diagnosis. In an emergency call 9-1-1; in crisis call or text 9-8-8._
